requires.description: Minimum Sumi version as a semver range, e.g. ">=0.4.0".

themeOverrides.description: Figure-wide refinements of the selected built-in theme. Omitted fields preserve the theme.

palette.description: Built-in color palette (sumi catalog --section palettes): recolors text, frames, lines, panels, filled and tinted nodes, the gray tone and emphasis of the theme. Other tones, sizes and fonts stay the theme's; tones, groupFill and groupStroke below refine it.

nodeCorners.description: Square node/group frames, including expanded matrix/tokens cells and legends. Intrinsically curved shapes are preserved.

edgeCorners.description: Sharp structured wires, including hidden junctions/forks, with butt caps and miter joins. Editable PPTX wires use flat caps and miter joins in both connector modes.

groupLabelWeight.description: Weight of group headings, overriding the theme's group variants.

solidFills.description: Exact #RRGGBB fills for solid tone nodes, including expanded token cells. Text remains contrast-adjusted.

dashedGroupStroke.description: Exact #RRGGBB border color for dashed groups; fill and heading color are preserved.

tones.description: Exact #RRGGBB colors of tones, applied wherever the tone is used; dimming still applies.

fill.description: The tone's pale fill: default, filled and tinted variants, toned groups, matrix classes.

line.description: The tone's line color: outlined/tinted frames, toned edges and arrowheads, hatches, solid fills (unless solidFills sets one).

text.description: The tone's text color, used as written: outlined/tinted text, toned edge labels, toned header text. Omitted: the line color (darkened to 4.5:1 on tinted fills).

groupFill.description: Exact #RRGGBB fill for container groups (and their stacked layers) that have a fill and no tone.

groupStroke.description: Exact #RRGGBB frame color for container groups (and their stacked layers); dashedGroupStroke wins for dashed groups.

target.description: Placement-specific lint targets; do not change layout, fonts, or width-only fitting.

height.description: Printed height budget, including margins; exceeding it warns but never rescales.

minFontSize.description: Minimum final text size (at least 4.5pt), overriding both profile font minima.

minLineWidth.description: Minimum final diagram border/wire width; thinner lines warn. Excludes image content.

fit.description: scale: shrink the whole figure (layout unchanged) to the profile's maximum width if it is wider; text is then checked at its printed size. Omitted means the figure is printed at its natural size.

engine.description: auto: D2/ELK. structured: arrange trees and attach. Omitted means structured if arrange is given, else auto.

direction.description: Flow direction of the root layout (auto engine only).

arrange.description: Structured layout: places the root-level nodes and groups.

align.description: Structured layout: elements of different arrange trees placed on one horizontal (y) or vertical (x) line.

alignGrowth.description: allow: the space the align constraints add is intended, so the info layout/align-grew-figure is not reported. Omitted means report (structured layout only).

fanIn.description: Edges from different elements entering the same point of an element without an anchor: merge joins them into one line, spread enters them side by side in the order of their other ends. Omitted means merge (structured layout only).

density.description: compact: the profile's tighter default gap, group padding and node padding, for dense paper figures (usually with fit: scale); gaps written in the figure stay as written. Omitted means normal (structured layout only).

assets.description: Images and inline SVGs defined once by name (an ID) and drawn by `image` nodes with props.asset, optionally cut with props.crop. Each is imported and checked once.

src.description: Path of the image file relative to the figure's YAML file, with "/" between directories, as image props.src.

svg.description: Inline SVG document, as image props.svg (a YAML block scalar with a viewBox). Exactly one of src or svg is required.

sha256.description: Expected sha256 of the file bytes or UTF-8 inline SVG source in hex. Rendering fails if the input has changed. Omitted means not checked.

props.description: Component options. Container supports layers: { count, offset } for stacked frames in structured layout; count includes the front card (1–16), offset is a positive 0.5pt-grid length up-right.

label.description: Plain text; newlines break lines. Empty or omitted means no label.

labelAt.description: Where the label sits inside the group's border, relative to the full frame including attached members, not just the arrange tree. Omitted means top (top centre) in structured layout and top-left in auto layout.

caption.description: Text drawn centred below the group's border, e.g. "(a) encoder". Drawn as a label with the reserved ID <id>-caption.

tone.description: Color category from the theme's palette (e.g. a pastel fill in the color theme, a gray step in monochrome themes). With variant outlined it colors the outline and text instead of the fill. Omitted means none.

dim.description: Draw the group and everything inside it (nodes, edges between them, nested groups, the caption, legends) in the theme's pale dim colors: gray text and lines, paler fills. Keeps the group's variant and tone; inherited and cannot be turned off inside. Omit it to draw the group as it is.

group.description: Parent group ID. Omitted means the root (or, in structured layout, the group whose arrange lists it).

arrange.description: Structured layout: places the group's children; listed elements become its children.

grow.description: Structured layout: relative weight of extra main-axis space under the immediate row/stack's justify: stretch (0 < grow <= 1000, default 1), apportioned in whole 0.5pt increments, not a final-size ratio. No effect without extra space, under other justification modes, in grid or attach, or on explicit main-axis sizes and non-stretchable shapes. Does not inherit. Rejected on expanded tokens, matrix and legend components.

label.description: Plain text; newlines break lines. Empty or omitted means no label.

sublabel.description: Structured layout: a second, smaller text under the label, e.g. a size "32 × 32 × 4" under "Noise". Drawn at 7/8 of the label's font size (rounded down to 0.5pt); newlines break lines and label math is allowed. Needs a label.

textAlign.description: Horizontal alignment of the node's label and sublabel within their shared text block (structured layout, or bubble in either layout). Omitted means center (left for bubbles and the entries of a legend).

labelRotation.description: Structured layout: draw the label turned by 90 (clockwise, reading top to bottom) or -90 degrees (counter-clockwise, reading bottom to top), e.g. a title along a tall box. The node is sized to the turned label.

icon.description: A bundled icon drawn in place of the label, e.g. tabler/wave-sine (text color) or emoji/fire (original multicolour palette).

badge.description: A one-em corner badge, independent of the node label; its overhang reserves layout space.

icon.description: Bundled icon, e.g. emoji/fire or emoji/snowflake.

corner.description: Corner of the node's bounding box on which the badge is centered.

glyphs.description: Small marks over the node's border, e.g. a three-cell feature vector at a corner of an icon; their overhang reserves layout space.

kind.description: vector: a short column or row of cells (a feature vector); dot: a small circle; pill: a small rounded bar.

at.description: Where the glyph's center lies on the node's body: a corner or the middle of a side. Omitted means north-east.

dx.description: Move the glyph right by this many ems (the node's font size); negative moves left.

dy.description: Move the glyph down by this many ems (the node's font size); negative moves up.

size.description: Side of one vector cell, or the diameter of a dot, or the height of a pill. Omitted means 0.4 em of the node's font size.

width.description: pill only: the length of the pill. Omitted means twice its height.

cells.description: vector only: the number of cells. Omitted means 3 (or the length of tones).

direction.description: vector only: lay the cells out downward (default) or rightward.

tone.description: The fill of every cell, the dot or the pill, from the theme's palette. none or omitted means the default node fill.

strength.description: soft (default): the tone's fill, as for a node. solid: the tone's accent color (its line color: a dark shade of the hue, a gray step in the monochrome themes) with a 0.5pt outline in the theme's ink, for readable small cells. none stays the plain node fill.

tones.description: vector only: one tone per cell, in order; its length is the cell count. Not combined with tone.

outline.description: Draw a thin outline around each cell, dot or pill (default true).

tone.description: Color category from the theme's palette (e.g. a pastel fill in the color theme, a gray step in monochrome themes). With variant outlined it colors the outline and text instead of the fill. Omitted means none.

mono.description: Draw the node's label and sublabel in the theme's monospace font (e.g. a class name or a prompt). false turns off a variant's monospace text. Math stays in the math fonts; \textcolor spans keep their colors. On a tokens node it is the default of its cells. Omitted means the variant's own setting (normally proportional text).

props.description: Component props, validated against the component manifest.

group.description: Containing group ID. Omitted means the root (or, in structured layout, the group whose arrange lists it).

attach.description: Structured layout: place this node beside another element instead of in an arrange tree.

to.description: The node or group to place this node beside, or a cell of a tokens node as <node>.<cell>.

side.description: The side or corner of the target to place this node on; a corner separates the boxes by gap on both axes.

gap.description: Space between the target and this node. Omitted means 0.

route.description: Join endpoints with one straight segment (straight) or cubic Bézier (curve), without obstacle avoidance or shared trunks (structured layout only). Curves share the through tangent at junctions. Omitted keeps orthogonal routing.

id.description: Optional edge ID (separate ID space from nodes and groups).

from.description: Source node or group ID, or a cell of a tokens node as <node>.<cell>.

fromAnchor.description: Where the edge leaves the source (structured layout only).

to.description: Target node or group ID, or a cell of a tokens node as <node>.<cell>.

toAnchor.description: Where the edge enters the target (structured layout only).

label.description: Plain text; newlines break lines. Empty or omitted means no label.

labelAt.description: Where along the route the label sits: beside the first segment (start), the longest segment (middle) or the last segment (end). Omitted means next to the arrowhead, or the middle of a line without arrowheads. With route: straight or curve, start/end are near that endpoint and the default is the arc-length midpoint (structured layout only).

labelSide.description: Which side of the line the label sits on, facing from the source to the target. Omitted means above a horizontal segment and right of a vertical one, or the other side when that is clear. With route: straight or curve, the default is left of the local tangent and labels stay horizontal without obstacle avoidance (structured layout only).

tone.description: Color category from the theme's palette for the line, its arrowheads and its label (the tone's line color, e.g. a dark orange in the color theme, a gray step in monochrome themes). Omitted means none.

props.description: Component props, validated against the component manifest.

sets.description: Set enclosures (#407): translucent shapes around nodes and groups that may overlap, for Venn diagrams and hyperedges. Structured layout only; they are drawn below the nodes and edges and take no space in the arrange trees.

id.description: Set ID (its own ID space, separate from nodes, groups and edges).

label.description: Plain text; newlines break lines. Empty or omitted means no label.

members.description: IDs of the nodes and groups the set encloses (each listed once). A group stands for its whole frame; the nodes inside it are members too.

shape.description: circle (default; the smallest circle around the members), ellipse (axis-parallel, up to 3:1), hull (rounded convex hull) or rect (rounded rectangle).

labelAt.description: Where the label sits outside the outline: top, top-right, right, bottom-right, bottom, bottom-left, left or top-left. Omitted means top.

padding.description: Room between the members and the outline. Omitted means the profile's group padding.

fillOpacity.description: Opacity of the tinted fill (0..1) so that overlapping sets show through each other. Omitted means the variant's own (0.2 for default and dashed, 0.28 for filled).

variant.description: default (tint and outline), filled (tint), outlined (outline) or dashed.

tone.description: Color category from the theme's palette: its line color draws the outline and the label and, at low opacity, the tint, in every theme. Omitted means gray.

centerOn.description: Keep this direct item's center at the box's main-axis center, reserving symmetric space for all items. Use a stack inside a centered row for side inputs. Only compatible with justify: center (the default).

gap.description: Space between items. Omitted means the theme/profile default.

align.description: Cross-axis alignment of the items. Omitted inherits from an enclosing box on the same axis.

justify.description: Extra main-axis space: center (default), stretch resizable items by grow weights (default 1) in whole 0.5pt increments, or space-between items. Does not inherit or act at natural size; explicit sizes and fixed-aspect shapes are preserved. Sub-unit remainder stays as centered padding.

items.description: Node or group IDs, or nested arrange boxes (stack / row / grid / place / chat).

centerOn.description: Keep this direct item's center at the box's main-axis center, reserving symmetric space for all items. Use a stack inside a centered row for side inputs. Only compatible with justify: center (the default).

gap.description: Space between items. Omitted means the theme/profile default.

align.description: Cross-axis alignment of the items. Omitted inherits from an enclosing box on the same axis.

justify.description: Extra main-axis space: center (default), stretch resizable items by grow weights (default 1) in whole 0.5pt increments, or space-between items. Does not inherit or act at natural size; explicit sizes and fixed-aspect shapes are preserved. Sub-unit remainder stays as centered padding.

items.description: Node or group IDs, or nested arrange boxes (stack / row / grid / place / chat).

columns.description: Number of columns; items fill left to right, top to bottom.

rowGap.description: A length with a unit (mm, cm, in or pt), e.g. "3mm"; 0 needs no unit.

columnGap.description: A length with a unit (mm, cm, in or pt), e.g. "3mm"; 0 needs no unit.

unit.description: A positive length with a unit (mm, cm, in or pt).

at.description: Item center [x, y] in units; y grows downward.

width.description: Column width; omitted uses the profile page width minus margins and one group's padding.

maxWidth.description: Maximum natural bubble width: a column fraction (0, 1] or a positive length. Default: 0.7.

anyOf.description: A positive length with a unit (mm, cm, in or pt).

tone.description: Color category from the theme's palette (e.g. a pastel fill in the color theme, a gray step in monochrome themes). With variant outlined it colors the outline and text instead of the fill. Omitted means none.

ArrangeBox.description: A stack (vertical), row (horizontal), row-major grid, rigid coordinate placement, or chat conversation column.

x.description: Node or group IDs (or tokens cells as <node>.<cell>) whose x (center, left or right edge) is made equal.

y.description: Node or group IDs (or tokens cells as <node>.<cell>) whose y (center, top or bottom edge) is made equal.

at.description: Which coordinate: center (default), start (top / left) or end (bottom / right).

AlignConstraint.description: Elements of any arrange trees placed on one line (structured layout only).
